commits.message: The word-motion size comment states what was measured and what a faster runner does (rich-unfiled-791c.jac3)

The word-motion linearity tests start at 64,000 characters, so a saturated suite no longer reaches the hang limit (rich-unfiled-791c.jac3)

Each motion timed five pairs at 256,000 and 1,024,000 characters: 11-15s of CPU
alone, 35s and a 30s timeout in a full-suite run on a machine at load 56-100.
A motion made quadratic still fails at the new size (ratio 10.3 against the bar of 8).

Underline review fixes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.nc7): an effect that moves a cell's ink draws its colored underline in it; SVG blinks by opacity so own-paint lines blink; reset and withoutColor clear underlineColor; underline decisions leave the send log; blink on underline keeps the cell's kind; underlineColor template sink; Windows Terminal 1.20 reads 4:n and 58; style.md example declares what the example terminal draws

Underline kinds and color as Style fields (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.nc7): Style.underline holds one kind (single, double, curly, dotted, dashed) so the later style decides it whole, doubleUnderline gone; underlineColor (SGR 58); one UNDERLINE table read by the encoder, decodeAnsi, parse, toString and template bindings; whether a destination draws 4:3-4:5 and 58 is picked once per console (style-effects.ts) and held on OutputTarget.underlines, a plain underline and no color otherwise; HTML and SVG draw wavy, dotted, dashed and colored lines

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

The loop-jump tests draw each fill once per strength, not once per field value per frame (rich-animation-27tq.0wj) (#601)

* The loop-jump tests draw each fill once per strength, not once per field value per frame

The 1 fps jump watch keyed its drawn-color cache on the raw field value,
which a continuous field (shimmer, sparkle) almost never repeats, while
drawnColor snaps every value to one of 96 strengths. About three quarters
of the test went on recomputing colors it had already drawn: shimmer 6.4s
alone, sparkle 4.2s, pulse ~4s, which a loaded full suite stretched past
the 30s hang limit. Keyed by the strength drawnColor itself draws at
(strengthOf, now exported beside it), they run in 0.3-1.2s with the same
assertions over the same colors.

* The jump watch draws each fill at the strength it keys on
Resume is pinned over half a second; the last depth rebuild is checked to keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
One frame per colour depth; pause is pinned at sixty frames a second over a tenth of a second; the rate and frame checks say what they read (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
One writtenOver check: what a window wrote must hold a gallery frame, and a depth rebuild must keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The no-color checks require a painted frame, so an empty window cannot pass them (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The colour-depth and pause playground tests play at one frame a second, so they no longer paint hundreds of unread gallery frames (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
